payrollLabBenchDescription: Seven reproducible gross scenarios using official CAO and table sources where applicable. Wage tax, net pay, deductions, and employer costs are not included.
payrollLabBenchNoRun: Run this comparison scenario. Its inputs, arrangement, and calculation version are stored immutably.

payrollLabBenchExactValuesNote: The source value appears in parentheses. Payslip amounts are rounded to euro cents for display only; exact engine results remain in the trace and JSON export.
payrollLabBenchK2TotalRoundingNote: K2: the CAO does not specify how these derived amounts are rounded. Each line and the exact total are rounded separately for display: €1,879.33 + €32.40 shows €1,911.73, while the gross total shows €1,911.74. Exact amounts are preserved in the calculation and export.
payrollLabBenchDisplayRounding: Display only: HALF_UP to EUR 0.01; exact source value is retained
payrollLabBenchBasis_K1: Scale 6, salary number 12; 36 of 36 weekly hours.
payrollLabBenchBasis_K2: September table €2,819; 24 of 36 hours; 4 example Sunday hours.
payrollLabBenchBasis_R1: Fashion group I, row 15; existing actual hourly wage €28.90; 38/38 hours.
payrollLabBenchBasis_R2: Fashion group C, row 1; 24/38 hours; two example premium hours.
payrollLabBenchBasis_B1: Band F, 40 weekly hours; midpoint used as gross hourly wage.
payrollLabBenchBasis_B2: Band F, €21.00 hourly wage, 32/40 hours; FTE normalization applies only to compa-ratio.
payrollLabBenchBasis_C1: Example of an individually agreed monthly wage; no required band or step.
payrollLabBenchMethod_K1: Published monthly table; twelve equal periods per year.
payrollLabBenchMethod_K2: Monthly wage × 24/36 plus a 45% supplement on the published hourly basis.
payrollLabBenchMethod_R1: Index actual hourly wage by 1.9%, capped at the July table; 164.67 × hourly wage × contract factor.
payrollLabBenchMethod_R2: 164.67 × table hourly wage × contract factor; choose only the most favorable applicable allowance for each overlapping hour.
payrollLabBenchMethod_B1: July midpoint rounded HALF_UP to cents; hourly wage × 40 × 52/12.
payrollLabBenchMethod_B2: Hourly wage × 32 × 52/12; FTE hourly wage divided by midpoint for compa-ratio.
payrollLabBenchMethod_C1: Individual monthly amount is emitted as gross salary; no band is applied.
payrollLabBenchH1Description: Separate scope analysis; no CAO wage is calculated.
payrollLabBenchH1Warning: This scenario is not an assessment of an employer or employee. Job title and salary alone do not establish CAO applicability.
payrollLabBenchH1ExplanationSupported: The scenario inputs describe an in-scope Metalektro employer, a function above the Basis CAO groups, and no director or policy-maker role.
payrollLabBenchH1ExplanationDirector: The scenario inputs describe a director; the HP scope excludes this role category.
payrollLabBenchH1ExplanationEvidenceGap: Employer scope and function level are unknown. Without evidence the result remains review required.
payrollLabBenchH1StatusNote: Applicability depends on documented employer-scope and function evidence.
payrollLabBenchRetailScopeNotice: This comparison includes only adult Mode table rows C/1 (R2) and I/15 (R1). Gross amounts exclude the 8% holiday allowance (vakantietoeslag) and public-holiday premiums. Other table rows, wage-history and review rules, tax, net pay, pension, and deductions are not included.
